title: IslandGen
description: This mod randomly generates Islands throughout the world. Not your simple prebuild survival island.
body:
This mod randomly generates Islands throughout the world. Not your simple prebuild survival island.

Features:

Random Generation
Starter hut
Loot Barrels spawning in the ocean (making it seem like loot from wrecked ships)
Hidden rooms with loot on islands (Configurable)
There is no Stronghold, but there is a portal. You just need to find it. Who knows, it might just be under your nose. :)

 

More will be added in future updates!
